The '''Candreal Gardens Center''' was located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] announced the appointment of [[Gerald Weizel]] to the post of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] at the center.
